items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: And Abby was a good boy. He's the nephew of the Merritt and Abby Brunis and Henry and the real Brunis family, Georgie and them.

ctx.x: Another fellow who's gone now, young Abby Brunis, the drummer. Do you have any recollections of him?

Oh, very much so. He was also a very good friend of mine. And I know Abby, we came up together. And Abby was a real fine Dixieland drummer too. In fact, I put him with Sharky when he started to come back playing Dixieland. That was in 1952. And he stayed with Sharky until he died. But Abby was a good boy. He's the nephew of the Merritt and Abby Brunis and Henry and the real Brunis family, Georgie and them. And the boy was just about hitting his height when he went on to Beyond's.
I understand that you helped Lizzie Miles with her comeback too.
